evidence: 283 comments (Xiaohongshu 想要什么软件？你说，我做！, 286 likes)
method: Read a Xiaohongshu thread where a nine-year software engineer publicly takes feature requests and answers each one with whether a product already exists — an unusually clean built-in 'is this solved' filter. He answered the手机控电脑 request with 向日葵/TeamViewer and the停车场 request with a cost objection, but answered the cooking-timer request with 我研究一下. Then checked the English side and found the same request twice, plus a shipped competitor. Cross-referenced the radar index: ⭐#375 (厨房跟做语音助手) already exists there with a one-line 论据 and no voices — this is its evidence.
gap: It hits a real pain but every product solves the storage half. Recipe apps compete on how many recipes they hold; the cook's problem is the twenty minutes at the stove. The Chinese request names the missing piece exactly — a timer per step and something that stops you improvising — and the developer taking requests had no product to point at.

zh.gap: 痛点击中了，但所有产品都在解「存」那一半。菜谱应用比的是谁的菜多；做饭的人的问题是灶台前那二十分钟。中文那条请求把缺的部分点得很准——每一步一个计时器，还要有个东西拦住你别灵机一动——而那位正在接需求的开发者，没有产品可以指给他。

zh.pain: 一个手上沾着生鸡肉、正用指关节去划一整屏文字的人，还得自己猜「炒香」到底是多久。
zh.kill: Parsnip 已经把这个形状在英文侧做出来了，450 关，还带着社区好感，所以英文那边不算开着。中文侧下厨房握着菜谱分发，加一个跟做模式就是一个版本的事。而做饭类应用的留存差得有原因，且这原因没人绕得过去：大多数家庭翻来覆去就做那八道菜——一个教你照着菜谱做的工具，用得最狠的正是那批很快就不再需要它的人。
zh.move: 别做菜谱库——那部分已经被人握着而且很挤。拿这个人已经找到的那一份菜谱（截图、小红书笔记、链接、菜谱书拍的一页），只把那一份变成免手跑完的流程：步骤念出来、计时自动起、说一声进下一步、含糊的指令展开成能对照的判断。切口是「你已经信的那份菜谱，它能直接跑」，而这恰好是有自己菜谱库的平台不会做的。冷启动（中文）：「想要什么软件？你说，我做！」那条 283 条评论的评论树，以及下厨房的 App Store 评论区；冷启动（英文）：r/cookingforbeginners 的 recipes as IKEA manuals 帖及其 32 条评论。
zh.hook: 一个两只手都是生鸡肉的人，正用指关节去划一整屏文字，猜「炒香」是什么意思。她不缺菜谱——菜谱就开着。她缺的是从现在到开饭那二十分钟。
zh.does: 把你已经找到的那份菜谱丢进去——截图、小红书笔记、链接、菜谱书的一张照片。它只把这一份变成一次免手操作的跑完：步骤念出来、计时器替你起、说一句就往下走、每一句含糊的指令都被翻成能核对的东西（「炒香」变成「大约 40 秒，蒜边发浅金色」）。
zh.counter: Parsnip 在英文侧已经做出了这个形状，450 关卡加社区口碑，英文这边不开放。中文侧下厨房握着菜谱分发，一个版本就能加步骤模式。还有一个没人绕过去的留存问题：大多数家庭常做的就那八道菜，所以用得最狠的正是马上就不再需要它的那批人。灶前的语音控制也比 demo 里脆弱得多——抽油烟机在响、油在炸、旁边还有个孩子在说话。
zh.differentiator: 一份菜谱都不拥有。楔子是「你已经找到的那份就能用」，而这恰恰是菜谱平台结构上不会做的事——它的生意就是那个库。冷启动（中）：小红书上那条请求已经被逐字写出来的评论区（「想要什么软件？你说，我做！」286赞/283评），加下厨房评论区里抱怨步骤在灶前没法用的人。冷启动（英）：r/cookingforbeginners，同一句「密密麻麻一整段」的抱怨跑到 139 分。
zh.consumer_angle: 拿走的人是今晚要做饭的普通人，手上是生的。她拿走的是这一道菜的一次免手跑完，不是一个菜谱库。

pain: Someone standing at the stove with raw chicken on their hands, trying to scroll a wall of text with a knuckle, guessing at what 'until fragrant' means.
kill: Parsnip already shipped this shape in English with 450 levels and community goodwill behind it, so the English side is not open. In Chinese, 下厨房 owns recipe distribution and can add a step mode in one release. And cooking-app retention is brutal for a reason nobody talks around: most households cook the same eight dishes, so a tool that teaches you to follow a recipe is used hardest by the people who will stop needing it.
move: Do not own a recipe library — that is the part that is already owned and already crowded. Take the recipe the person already found (a screenshot, a Xiaohongshu note, a link, a photo of a cookbook page) and convert that one into a hands-free run: steps read aloud, timers started automatically, advance by voice, and the vague instructions expanded into a checkable cue. The wedge is 'works with whatever recipe you already trust', which is exactly what a platform with its own library will not build. Cold start (Chinese): the comment tree of 「想要什么软件？你说，我做！」 (283 comments) and the 下厨房 App Store review section; Cold start (English): r/cookingforbeginners, the 'recipes as IKEA manuals' thread and its 32 comments.
hook: Someone standing at the stove with raw chicken on both hands, trying to scroll a wall of text with a knuckle, guessing what 'until fragrant' means. She is not short of recipes — she has the recipe open. She is short of the twenty minutes between here and dinner.
does: Give it the recipe you already found — a screenshot, a Xiaohongshu note, a link, a photo of a cookbook page. It converts that one into a hands-free run: steps read aloud, timers started for you, advance by voice, and every vague instruction expanded into something you can actually check ('fragrant' becomes 'about 40 seconds, when the garlic edges go pale gold').
counter: Parsnip already shipped this shape in English with 450 levels and community goodwill, so the English side is not open. In Chinese, 下厨房 owns recipe distribution and can add a step mode in one release. And the retention problem nobody talks around: most households cook the same eight dishes, so the tool is used hardest by exactly the people about to stop needing it. Voice control over a hot stove is also less reliable than a demo suggests — extractor fan on, oil spitting, one child talking.
differentiator: Own no recipes. The wedge is 'works with whatever you already found', which is the one thing a recipe platform structurally will not do, because its business is the library. Cold start (Chinese): the 小红书 comment threads where the request is already written out verbatim (「想要什么软件？你说，我做！」286赞/283评), plus 下厨房 review sections where people complain the steps are unusable at the stove. Cold start (English): r/cookingforbeginners, where the same 'dense blocks of text' complaint runs 139 points.
consumer_angle: 拿走的人是今晚要做饭的普通人，手上是生的。她拿走的是这一道菜的一次免手操作跑完——步骤念出来、计时器自动起、说一句「下一步」、以及「炒香」被翻成「大约 40 秒，蒜边发浅金色」。不是一个菜谱库。
